```{r}

cond_prop_levels <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data%>%
  dplyr::count(sample.name, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5) %>%
  filter(sample.name == "HSC_WT_CD41+")%>%
  mutate(cond_prop = n/sum(n),
         sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 = as.character(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5)) %>% 
  arrange(cond_prop)%>%
  pull(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5)

clust_prop_levels <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data%>%
  dplyr::count(sample.name, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5) %>%
  filter(sample.name == "HSC_WT_CD41+")%>%
  mutate(clust_prop = n/sum(n),
         sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 = as.character(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5)) %>% 
  arrange(clust_prop)%>%
  pull(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data%>%
  dplyr::count(sample.name, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5) %>%
  group_by(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5) %>%
  mutate(clust_prop = n/sum(n))%>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(sample.name) %>% 
  mutate(cond_prop = n/sum(n)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 = factor(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5, levels =cond_prop_levels),
         sample.name = factor(sample.name,
                              levels = c("HSC_WT_CD41+", "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh-","HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+")) 
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5,cond_prop, fill = sample.name))+
  geom_col(position = position_dodge())+
  coord_flip()+
  facet_wrap(~sample.name)+
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_line(colour = "grey90"),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 10))


```

```{r}
x <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data%>%
  dplyr::count(sample.name,sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5)%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = sample.name, values_from = n)%>%
  mutate(x_col = 1,
         sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5 = as.numeric(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5))

ggplot()+
  scatterpie::geom_scatterpie(aes(x_col,
                                  sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5,
                                  group = sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5,r = 0.5),
                              data = x,
                              cols = colnames(x)[2:4])+coord_flip()+theme(legend.position = "top")

```


```{r alluvial_plot}
library(ggalluvial)

mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::count(sample.name, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5) %>%
  group_by(sample.name) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    sample.name = factor(sample.name,
                         levels = c("HSC_WT_CD41+", "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh-", "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+")),
    cluster = factor(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.5, levels =rev(cond_prop_levels))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sample.name, y = prop,
             stratum = cluster, alluvium = cluster,
             fill = cluster, label = cluster)) +
  geom_flow(stat = "alluvium", aes.flow = "forward", alpha = 0.6,
            color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_stratum(alpha = 0.9, color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum", size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colorspace::sequential_hcl(16, palette = "Batlow")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Proportion of condition", fill = "Cluster") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

  group_by(group1) %>%
  slice_min(n = 1,order_by = min_padj) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pull(feature) %>%
  unique()
